name: Percentage calculator
summary: Percent of, change, discount, markup, margin
author: friday-core
description: Answers percentage questions exactly: X percent of Y, A is what percent of B, change from A to B (increase or decrease), add or take off a percent, a discount (20% off 1500) and markup versus margin from a cost and a selling price. Understands Indian number grouping (1,50,000) and a few Hinglish words (ka, pe, chhoot).
